data.explanation: This is your annual operating cost statement (Betriebskostenabrechnung) from your landlord's property manager. It shows you owe an additional €263.18 because your advance payments in 2025 were lower than your actual share of costs. You should pay this amount by the deadline shown in the app, which is calculated from when you received this letter. If you have questions about the cost breakdown (the itemised list is mentioned as enclosed but not included here), you can ask the management company for details before paying.
